# What this notebook does

Kate, 2026-10-30. The reporter z-score plots (`43_reporter_candidate_feature_zscores.Rmd`)
suggest that an eIF3d target needs a long enough 5'UTR, a short CDS **and** AU-rich third codon
positions. This notebook asks whether that is really an "all three" rule or whether the three
simply add up.

- **The grid** is the GC3 x CDS length heatmap of `37_utr_cds_length_models.Rmd` /
  `38_normoxia_gc3_length_te.Rmd`, drawn once per 5'UTR length group so that 5'UTR becomes the
  third axis. Each cell shows the mean TE change (sictrl vs si3d) of every gene in
  it, and separately the fraction that are eIF3d targets.
- **Bins are set once on all genes**, not within each panel, so the same cell means the same GC3
  and CDS range in every panel and the panels can be compared cell by cell. All panels share one
  color scale.
- **How to read it.** If the features add up, color changes smoothly and the contours run
  diagonally: a gene can make up for a long CDS by being very AU3-rich. If eIF3d really needs all
  three, only the corner with short CDS, low GC3 and a long 5'UTR lights up, as a rectangle.
- **TE source is a parameter** (`de_file`). Genes, features, z-scores and bins are the same in
  every run (all from the hypoxia 1hr model's gene list and the feature matrix); only the TE
  outcome and the targets change, as in `38_`. This run: **`r params$label`**, TE from
  `output/`r params$de_file``.
- **Genes:** the 10,054 modelled genes with all three features (the same set as the z-score
  plots), minus EIF3D, whose own TE change is a knockdown artefact. 37_'s grids use 10,038,
  because they also require a 3'UTR length.

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(here) })
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
SAVE <- isTRUE(params$save_plots)
TOL <- 1e-12
NB <- as.integer(params$n_bins); NU <- as.integer(params$n_utr5)
stopifnot("n_bins must be >= 2" = NB >= 2, "n_utr5 must be >= 2" = NU >= 2)
```

# 1. Data and checks

```{r data}
de <- read_csv(here("output", params$de_file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("[.].*", "", gene_id))
kd <- de$rna_lfc[de$symbol %in% "EIF3D"]
stopifnot("duplicate genes in the DE file" = !anyDuplicated(de$gene_id_clean),
          "EIF3D not found once" = length(kd) == 1,
          "EIF3D rna_lfc not > 1: wrong file or flipped direction" = kd > 1)
cat(sprintf("%s: EIF3D rna_lfc %+.2f -> log2(sictrl / si3d), positive = eIF3d promotes\n", params$de_file, kd))

# The model supplies the gene list only; TE and targets come from de_file
mg <- readRDS(file.path(O, paste0("shap_oof_", params$suffix, ".rds")))$genes
stopifnot("model genes missing from the DE file" = all(mg$gene_id_clean %in% de$gene_id_clean),
          "tag must name the TE source" = nzchar(params$tag))
same_te_as_model <- max(abs(mg$y - de$te_lfc[match(mg$gene_id_clean, de$gene_id_clean)])) < TOL
fm <- readRDS(file.path(O, params$matrix_rds))
stopifnot("matrix has duplicate genes" = !anyDuplicated(fm$gene_id_clean),
          "model genes missing from the matrix" = all(mg$gene_id_clean %in% fm$gene_id_clean))
num <- function(col) as.numeric(unlist(fm[[col]][match(mg$gene_id_clean, fm$gene_id_clean)]))
d <- mg %>% transmute(gene_id_clean, symbol, model_target = set == "eIF3d promoted",
                      te_lfc = de$te_lfc[match(gene_id_clean, de$gene_id_clean)],
                      te_padj = de$te_padj[match(gene_id_clean, de$gene_id_clean)],
                      gc3 = num("gc3_internal"), cds = num("log2_cds_length"), utr5 = num("log2_utr5_length"),
                      cds_nt = num("cds_length"), utr5_nt = num("utr5_length")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gc3), !is.na(cds), !is.na(utr5))
stopifnot("log2 lengths are not log2(nt + 1)" =
            max(abs(d$cds - log2(d$cds_nt + 1)), abs(d$utr5 - log2(d$utr5_nt + 1))) < TOL,
          "GC3 outside [0, 100]" = all(d$gc3 >= 0 & d$gc3 <= 100),
          "GC3 median outside 40-65%" = between(median(d$gc3), 40, 65),
          "TE missing for a modelled gene" = !anyNA(d$te_lfc),
          "log fold changes not finite" = all(is.finite(d$te_lfc)))
d <- d %>% mutate(target = !is.na(te_padj) & te_lfc > params$lfc & te_padj < params$padj)
# When the TE source is the model's own, the inline targets must be the model's targets
if (same_te_as_model) stopifnot("inline targets differ from the model's" = identical(d$target, d$model_target))
cat(sprintf("TE source is %s the hypoxia 1hr model's own outcome\n", if (same_te_as_model) "" else "NOT"))

# Same genes as the z-score plots
zg <- read_csv(file.path(O, params$zscore_csv), show_col_types = FALSE)$gene_id_clean
stopifnot("gene set differs from the z-score plots" = setequal(zg, d$gene_id_clean))
if (nzchar(params$geneset_csv)) {
  gs <- sub("[.].*", "", read_csv(here("output", "genesets", params$geneset_csv), show_col_types = FALSE)$ensembl_gene)
  stopifnot("targets differ from the saved gene-set CSV" = setequal(d$gene_id_clean[d$target], intersect(gs, d$gene_id_clean)))
}
# Favorable = long 5'UTR, short CDS, low GC3 was read off hypoxia 1hr; check it holds for this TE source
rho <- c(utr5 = cor(d$utr5, d$te_lfc, method = "spearman"), cds = cor(d$cds, d$te_lfc, method = "spearman"),
         gc3 = cor(d$gc3, d$te_lfc, method = "spearman"))
print(round(rho, 3))
stopifnot("a feature's direction differs for this TE source - 'favorable' would be mislabelled" =
            rho[["utr5"]] > 0 && rho[["cds"]] < 0 && rho[["gc3"]] < 0)

d <- d %>% filter(symbol != "EIF3D")
stopifnot("EIF3D not removed exactly once" = nrow(d) == length(zg) - 1)
cat(sprintf("genes %s; eIF3d %s targets %s (%.1f%%); mean TE change %+.3f\n",
            scales::comma(nrow(d)), params$cond_word, scales::comma(sum(d$target)), 100 * mean(d$target), mean(d$te_lfc)))
```

## Bins

```{r bins}
# Equal-count bins on all genes, labelled in natural units (as in 37_ / 38_)
q_lab <- function(x, n) {
  br <- unique(quantile(x, seq(0, 1, length.out = n + 1)))
  cut(x, br, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = sprintf("%s-%s", scales::comma(round(2^head(br, -1) - 1)), scales::comma(round(2^br[-1] - 1))))
}
q_lab_pct <- function(x, n) {
  br <- unique(quantile(x, seq(0, 1, length.out = n + 1)))
  cut(x, br, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = sprintf("%.1f-%.1f", head(br, -1), br[-1]))
}
d <- d %>% mutate(bx = q_lab(cds, NB), by = q_lab_pct(gc3, NB), bu = q_lab(utr5, NU),
                  bf = factor(if_else(utr5_nt <= params$utr5_floor_nt,
                                      sprintf("<= %d nt", params$utr5_floor_nt), sprintf("> %d nt", params$utr5_floor_nt)),
                              levels = sprintf(c("<= %d nt", "> %d nt"), params$utr5_floor_nt)))
stopifnot("CDS bins collapsed" = nlevels(d$bx) == NB, "GC3 bins collapsed" = nlevels(d$by) == NB,
          "5'UTR groups collapsed" = nlevels(d$bu) == NU, "a gene is unbinned" = !anyNA(d[, c("bx", "by", "bu", "bf")]),
          "bins out of order" = all(diff(tapply(d$cds, d$bx, median)) > 0) && all(diff(tapply(d$gc3, d$by, median)) > 0) &&
            all(diff(tapply(d$utr5, d$bu, median)) > 0))
# Equal count up to ties: every bin within 10% of n / bins
eq <- function(f, k) all(abs(table(f) - nrow(d) / k) / (nrow(d) / k) < 0.10)
stopifnot("CDS bins not equal-count" = eq(d$bx, NB), "GC3 bins not equal-count" = eq(d$by, NB))
print(table(`5'UTR group` = d$bu)); print(table(`5'UTR floor split` = d$bf))
```

# 2. The grids

```{r grid_fun}
grid_cells <- function(dd, panel) dd %>% group_by(panel = .data[[panel]], bx, by) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), lfc = mean(te_lfc), frac = mean(target), .groups = "drop")

# Independent recomputation of every cell with base R, and a pooling check against the unsplit grid
check_cells <- function(gc, dd, panel) {
  key <- paste(dd[[panel]], dd$bx, dd$by)
  m <- tapply(dd$te_lfc, key, mean); f <- tapply(dd$target, key, mean); k <- paste(gc$panel, gc$bx, gc$by)
  stopifnot("cell means differ from base-R recomputation" = max(abs(gc$lfc - m[k])) < TOL,
            "cell fractions differ from base-R recomputation" = max(abs(gc$frac - f[k])) < TOL,
            "cells do not add up to the genes" = sum(gc$n) == nrow(dd),
            "every panel must have every cell" = nrow(gc) == nlevels(dd[[panel]]) * NB^2)
  pooled <- gc %>% group_by(bx, by) %>% summarise(lfc = sum(lfc * n) / sum(n), .groups = "drop")
  flat <- dd %>% group_by(bx, by) %>% summarise(lfc = mean(te_lfc), .groups = "drop")
  stopifnot("panels do not pool back to the unsplit grid" = max(abs(pooled$lfc - flat$lfc)) < 1e-10)
}

plot_grid <- function(gc, what, panel_title, file_tag) {
  val <- if (what == "lfc") gc$lfc else 100 * gc$frac
  lab <- if (what == "lfc") sprintf("%+.2f\nn = %d", gc$lfc, gc$n) else sprintf("%.0f%%\nn = %d", 100 * gc$frac, gc$n)
  lim <- range(val)
  stopifnot("shared scale must cover every panel" = all(val >= lim[1] & val <= lim[2]))
  pn <- gc %>% group_by(panel) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
  gc <- gc %>% mutate(val = val, lab = lab,
                      panel = factor(sprintf("%s %s (n = %s)", panel_title, panel, scales::comma(pn$n[match(panel, pn$panel)])),
                                     levels = sprintf("%s %s (n = %s)", panel_title, pn$panel, scales::comma(pn$n))))
  p <- ggplot(gc, aes(bx, by, fill = val)) + geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = lab), size = if (NB > 5) 2.1 else 2.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ panel, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = params$grid_color, limits = lim,
                        name = if (what == "lfc") "mean log2 TE\nsictrl vs si3d" else "targets (%)") +
    labs(x = sprintf("CDS length (nt), %d equal-count bins", NB), y = sprintf("GC3 (%%), %d equal-count bins", NB),
         title = sprintf("%s: %s by GC3 and CDS length, split by 5'UTR length", params$label,
                         if (what == "lfc") "mean TE change" else "eIF3d target fraction"),
         subtitle = sprintf("%s; bins set on all %s genes so cells match across panels; one color scale for all panels; overall %s",
                            if (what == "lfc") "mean log2(sictrl / si3d) of every gene in the cell" else
                              sprintf("share of the cell's genes that are eIF3d %s targets (TE LFC > %s, padj < %s)", params$cond_word, params$lfc, params$padj),
                            scales::comma(nrow(d)),
                            if (what == "lfc") sprintf("mean %+.3f", mean(d$te_lfc)) else sprintf("%.1f%% targets", 100 * mean(d$target)))) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8),
          strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
  print(p)
  if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", sprintf("44_%s_grid_gc3_vs_cds_by_utr5_%s_%dbins_%s.pdf",
                                         if (what == "lfc") "mean_lfc" else "target_fraction", file_tag, NB, params$tag)),
                   p, width = 5.2 * NB / 5 * nlevels(gc$panel) + 1.5, height = 6 * max(1, NB / 7))
}
```

## 5'UTR in equal-count groups

```{r grid_tertiles, fig.width = 3.4 * NB + 1.5, fig.height = 6 * max(1, NB / 7)}
gu <- grid_cells(d, "bu"); check_cells(gu, d, "bu")
plot_grid(gu, "lfc", "5'UTR", paste0("utr5_", NU, "groups"))
plot_grid(gu, "frac", "5'UTR", paste0("utr5_", NU, "groups"))
```

## 5'UTR split at the floor (<= `r params$utr5_floor_nt` nt vs longer)

The z-score plots showed the 5'UTR effect is a floor: very short 5'UTRs are under-targeted and
the rate is flat above ~50 nt. The short group is small (cells hold few genes), so read the
gradient rather than single cells.

```{r grid_floor, fig.width = 2.1 * NB + 1.5, fig.height = 6 * max(1, NB / 7)}
gf <- grid_cells(d, "bf"); check_cells(gf, d, "bf")
plot_grid(gf, "lfc", "5'UTR", "utr5_floor")
plot_grid(gf, "frac", "5'UTR", "utr5_floor")
```

## The corners in numbers

The favorable corner is the shortest-CDS, lowest-GC3 cell; the unfavorable corner is the
longest-CDS, highest-GC3 cell. If the features add up, the gap between the corners should be about
the same in every 5'UTR panel, with the whole grid shifted up for longer 5'UTRs. If all three are
needed, the gap should open up only in the long-5'UTR panel.

```{r corners}
corner <- gu %>% filter((bx == levels(d$bx)[1] & by == levels(d$by)[1]) | (bx == levels(d$bx)[NB] & by == levels(d$by)[NB])) %>%
  mutate(corner = if_else(bx == levels(d$bx)[1], "favorable", "unfavorable")) %>%
  dplyr::select(panel, corner, n, lfc, frac) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = corner, values_from = c(n, lfc, frac)) %>%
  mutate(lfc_gap = lfc_favorable - lfc_unfavorable, frac_gap = frac_favorable - frac_unfavorable)
knitr::kable(corner, digits = 3, caption = "corner cells per 5'UTR group: mean TE change and target fraction")
# Direction sanity: in every 5'UTR panel the favorable corner must beat the unfavorable one
stopifnot("favorable corner not above unfavorable corner in some 5'UTR panel" = all(corner$lfc_gap > 0))
```

# 3. Staircase: target rate by number of favorable features

Each gene is scored favorable or not on each feature using the oriented z-scores from the
z-score plots (CDS length and GC3 negated, so favorable = long 5'UTR, short CDS, AU-rich GC3):

- **z > 0**: above the mean of all genes on that feature (roughly half the genes);
- **top third**: in the most favorable third of genes on that feature (stricter).

The shape of the staircase is the test: even steps = the features add up; flat then a jump at 3 =
all three needed; a jump at 1 then flat = any one is enough.

```{r staircase_data}
zi <- read_csv(file.path(O, params$zscore_csv), show_col_types = FALSE)
zi <- zi[match(d$gene_id_clean, zi$gene_id_clean), ]
stopifnot("z table out of step with the genes" = identical(zi$gene_id_clean, d$gene_id_clean),
          "z table raw values differ from the matrix" = max(abs(zi$gc3 - d$gc3), abs(zi$cds - d$cds), abs(zi$utr5 - d$utr5)) < TOL)
d <- d %>% mutate(o_utr5 = zi$z_utr5, o_cds = -zi$z_cds, o_gc3 = -zi$z_gc3)
# z > 0 must be the same as being on the favorable side of the background mean (the z background is d + EIF3D)
bg_mean <- function(v) mean(c(d[[v]], read_csv(file.path(O, params$zscore_csv), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
                                filter(!gene_id_clean %in% d$gene_id_clean) %>% pull(v)))
stopifnot("z > 0 is not utr5 above its mean" = identical(d$o_utr5 > 0, d$utr5 > bg_mean("utr5")),
          "-z > 0 is not cds below its mean" = identical(d$o_cds > 0, d$cds < bg_mean("cds")),
          "-z > 0 is not gc3 below its mean" = identical(d$o_gc3 > 0, d$gc3 < bg_mean("gc3")))
cut_rules <- list(`z > 0` = function(x) x > 0, `top third` = function(x) x > quantile(x, 2 / 3))
fav <- imap_dfr(cut_rules, function(f, rule) d %>%
  transmute(gene_id_clean, target, te_lfc, rule = rule,
            utr5_fav = f(o_utr5), cds_fav = f(o_cds), gc3_fav = f(o_gc3)) %>%
  mutate(n_fav = utr5_fav + cds_fav + gc3_fav))
fav$rule <- factor(fav$rule, levels = names(cut_rules))
fav %>% group_by(rule) %>% summarise(utr5 = mean(utr5_fav), cds = mean(cds_fav), gc3 = mean(gc3_fav)) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "share of genes favorable on each feature")
stopifnot("every gene scored under both rules" = all(table(fav$rule) == nrow(d)))
```

```{r staircase_plot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4.8}
# Wilson 95% interval for a proportion
wilson <- function(k, n, z = 1.96) { p <- k / n; c0 <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / (1 + z^2 / n)
  h <- z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2)) / (1 + z^2 / n); cbind(lo = c0 - h, hi = c0 + h) }
st <- fav %>% group_by(rule, n_fav) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), k = sum(target), rate = mean(target), lfc = mean(te_lfc), .groups = "drop")
st <- bind_cols(st, as_tibble(wilson(st$k, st$n)))
stopifnot("staircase counts do not add up" = all(tapply(st$n, st$rule, sum) == nrow(d)),
          "staircase targets do not add up" = all(tapply(st$k, st$rule, sum) == sum(d$target)),
          "all-favorable rate not above none-favorable" = all(st$rate[st$n_fav == 3] > st$rate[st$n_fav == 0]))
knitr::kable(st, digits = 3)
p_st <- ggplot(st, aes(factor(n_fav), 100 * rate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100 * mean(d$target), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_col(fill = "#E69F00", width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 100 * lo, ymax = 100 * hi), width = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 100 * hi, label = sprintf("%.1f%%\nn = %s", 100 * rate, scales::comma(n))), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ rule, labeller = labeller(rule = function(x) paste("favorable =", x))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  labs(x = "number of favorable features (long 5'UTR, short CDS, AU-rich GC3)", y = sprintf("eIF3d %s targets (%%)", params$cond_word),
       title = sprintf("%s: eIF3d target rate by number of favorable features", params$label),
       subtitle = sprintf("bars = share of genes that are targets, 95%% Wilson CI; dashed = overall %.1f%%; n = %s genes, %s targets",
                          100 * mean(d$target), scales::comma(nrow(d)), scales::comma(sum(d$target)))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8), strip.background = element_blank())
p_st
if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", paste0("44_staircase_target_rate_by_n_favorable_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_st, width = 10, height = 4.8)
```

## Which features? All eight combinations against an additive expectation

The staircase pools, for example, "short CDS only" with "AU-rich only". Splitting it into the
eight combinations asks which features carry the rate, and in particular whether a gene needs
**a short CDS or AU-rich GC3** (either one being enough) rather than both.

Black points are what an **additive model** predicts for each combination: a logistic
regression of target status on the three favorable/unfavorable flags with no interaction terms,
so each feature multiplies the odds by the same amount whatever the others are. Bars above the
point mean the combination does better than the features add up to; bars below mean worse.

- **"Either is enough"** predicts CDS-only and GC3-only each close to CDS + GC3, with CDS + GC3
  *below* its additive point (adding the second gains less than expected).
- **"All three needed"** predicts the all-favorable bar *above* its point and the rest near the floor.

```{r combos, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 5.5}
lr <- list(); cb <- list()
for (r in levels(fav$rule)) {
  fr <- fav %>% filter(rule == r)
  m_add <- glm(target ~ utr5_fav + cds_fav + gc3_fav, family = binomial, data = fr)
  m_full <- glm(target ~ utr5_fav * cds_fav * gc3_fav, family = binomial, data = fr)
  fr$pred_add <- fitted(m_add); fr$pred_full <- fitted(m_full)
  lt <- anova(m_add, m_full, test = "LRT")
  lr[[r]] <- tibble(rule = r, interaction_df = lt$Df[2], deviance = lt$Deviance[2], p = lt$`Pr(>Chi)`[2])
  co <- coef(m_full)
  cb[[r]] <- fr %>% group_by(rule, utr5_fav, cds_fav, gc3_fav, n_fav) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), k = sum(target), rate = mean(target), additive = mean(pred_add), saturated = mean(pred_full), .groups = "drop")
  lr[[r]]$cds_x_gc3 <- co[["cds_favTRUE:gc3_favTRUE"]]
}
cb <- bind_rows(cb); lr <- bind_rows(lr)
# Fitting check: the saturated model reproduces every observed combination rate exactly
stopifnot("saturated logistic does not reproduce the observed rates" = max(abs(cb$saturated - cb$rate)) < 1e-8,
          "every rule has all eight combinations" = all(table(cb$rule) == 8),
          "combination counts do not add up" = all(tapply(cb$n, cb$rule, sum) == nrow(d)))
cb <- bind_cols(cb, as_tibble(wilson(cb$k, cb$n))) %>%
  mutate(combo = pmap_chr(list(utr5_fav, cds_fav, gc3_fav), function(u, c, g) {
           s <- c(if (u) "5'UTR", if (c) "CDS", if (g) "GC3"); if (length(s)) paste(s, collapse = " + ") else "none" }))
lev <- c("none", "5'UTR", "CDS", "GC3", "5'UTR + CDS", "5'UTR + GC3", "CDS + GC3", "5'UTR + CDS + GC3")
cb$combo <- factor(cb$combo, levels = lev)
stopifnot("unexpected combination label" = !anyNA(cb$combo))
knitr::kable(cb %>% dplyr::select(rule, combo, n, k, rate, additive, lo, hi), digits = 3,
             caption = "observed target rate per combination vs the additive (no-interaction) logistic model")
knitr::kable(lr, digits = 4, caption = "do interactions improve on the additive model? (likelihood-ratio test, 4 df); cds_x_gc3 = CDS x GC3 log-odds interaction in the full model (negative = either is enough)")
p_cb <- ggplot(cb, aes(combo, 100 * rate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100 * mean(d$target), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_col(aes(fill = factor(n_fav)), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 100 * lo, ymax = 100 * hi), width = 0.2) +
  geom_point(aes(y = 100 * additive), color = "black", size = 2.2, shape = 18) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 0, label = sprintf("n = %s", scales::comma(n))), vjust = 1.5, size = 2.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ rule, ncol = 1, labeller = labeller(rule = function(x) paste("favorable =", x))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "grey85", "1" = "#F5D9A6", "2" = "#EEBB5C", "3" = "#E69F00"), name = "favorable\nfeatures") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.12, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "which features are favorable", y = sprintf("eIF3d %s targets (%%)", params$cond_word),
       title = sprintf("%s: eIF3d target rate by combination of favorable features", params$label),
       subtitle = sprintf("bars = observed, 95%% Wilson CI; black diamonds = additive logistic model (no interactions); dashed = overall %.1f%%; n = %s genes",
                          100 * mean(d$target), scales::comma(nrow(d)))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8), strip.background = element_blank())
p_cb
if (SAVE) ggsave(here("plots", paste0("44_combination_target_rate_vs_additive_", params$tag, ".pdf")), p_cb, width = 12, height = 7.5)
```
